programs.title: Distant Shores
programs.desc: Arrive at the tiny island of Isla Graciosa following a 3-day offshore passage from Morocco. Hike this desert island and then sail to the beautiful volcanic island of Lanzarote before heading to the island of Gran Canaria.

programs.title: Selling Yachts
programs.desc: Jen hopes to sway Eric towards a sailing lifestyle. Jeff Sorgen, dials up a 52' Irwin sailboat for consideration. Looking to impress, Tom asked to see something larger. Shannon McCoy, sets up a tour of the massive 100' Paragon "Bahamas Skymaster.

programs.title: Road Less Traveled

programs.title: A Taste of Travel
programs.desc: Travelling to some of the most idyllic places to try the local cuisine that each destination has to offer, and some travel tips along the way. Featuring the delights of Sorrento in Italy to the delacasies of South Africa.
